US-Iran tensions rise over nuclear ambitions and potential military action

US intelligence assesses that Iran's Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, may be more interested in developing nuclear weapons than his predecessor. This assessment comes as US President Donald Trump considers expanding military operations against Tehran. Amidst these tensions, Iran's army issued a warning ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's US visit. Reports also suggest Iran will halt attacks if the US maintains a pause, following Trump's decision to call off strikes.
